method: Vision inspection of actual-source poster and offline browser captures after acceptance run
observed: Pale cracked basin and two distinct rear ridges visible at 390px mobile size
Terracotta body, gold/copper-colored hardware and feet framed without clipping
Open-rear view shows hollow cavity and lid-borne terrain without obvious floating components
No stale Japan visible copy in mobile view
limitations: Salt basin reads as a raised crust insert, not a depressed excavation
Fine crack detail is subtle on mobile; ridges are deliberately faceted
Body mineral bands are procedural and regular; dark gasket seam is pronounced
Hardware reads brass/copper-colored rather than pure polished copper
Still images cannot establish offline operation or motion; those are separately tested in browser-check and source-check
No photorealism, geographic equivalence, continuous collision proof or physical-phone performance claimed
